# Commands

Every command of the registry this skill was generated from. `passportsim --help` lists the commands of the binary you have and `passportsim <command> --help` prints one command's synopsis and arguments; where they differ from these pages, the binary is right. The MCP server (`passportsim mcp`) serves the core tools; `--caps` adds the other groups.

| Command | MCP tool | Group | macOS | Windows | Browser | Summary |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| [`audio_capture`](commands/audio_capture.md) | `passport_audio_capture` | `audio` | yes | yes | yes | Capture the guest's audio output as a WAV artifact with its fundamental and peak. |
| [`ble_connect`](commands/ble_connect.md) | `passport_ble_connect` | `radio` | yes | yes | yes | Connect the scripted BLE central to an advertiser, or end its connection. |
| [`ble_gatt`](commands/ble_gatt.md) | `passport_ble_gatt` | `radio` | yes | yes | yes | Run the scripted BLE central's GATT client, or take its btsnoop capture. |
| [`ble_scan`](commands/ble_scan.md) | `passport_ble_scan` | `radio` | yes | yes | yes | Scan the virtual air with the scripted BLE central. |
| [`clock`](commands/clock.md) | `passport_clock` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Show or take the clock lease, pace it, or step instructions. |
| [`device_boot_check`](commands/device_boot_check.md) | `passport_device_boot_check` | `device` | yes | yes | no | Read the AI Passport's boot console against an image, optionally restarting it first. |
| [`doctor`](commands/doctor.md) | `passport_doctor` | `core` | yes | yes | no | Report the bundled ROM pins, any ROM override and every corpus entry. |
| [`endpoint`](commands/endpoint.md) | `passport_endpoint` | `debug` | yes | yes | no | Open, describe or close an instance's USB Serial/JTAG endpoints for esptool and idf.py. |
| [`env`](commands/env.md) | `passport_env` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Change the world around the device: battery, USB, NFC, microphone, Wi-Fi air, HCI bridge. |
| [`flash_device`](commands/flash_device.md) | `passport_flash_device` | `device` | yes | yes | no | Flash the connected AI Passport with a planned, confirmed and rehearsed image. |
| [`input`](commands/input.md) | `passport_input` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Press a button, hold power, or plug the USB cable. |
| [`inspect`](commands/inspect.md) | `passport_inspect` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Read the guest's tasks, heap, NVS, LVGL objects and fidelity table. |
| [`mic_set`](commands/mic_set.md) | `passport_mic_set` | `audio` | yes | yes | yes | Set the microphone source and inject its samples. |
| [`net_capture`](commands/net_capture.md) | `passport_net_capture` | `radio` | yes | yes | yes | Read the Wi-Fi data plane's pcap capture, or write it as an artifact. |
| [`net_http`](commands/net_http.md) | `passport_net_http` | `radio` | yes | yes | yes | Report the virtual LAN, or bridge an allowlisted port to a server on the host. |
| [`nfc_tag`](commands/nfc_tag.md) | `passport_nfc_tag` | `nfc` | yes | yes | yes | Load NDEF records onto the NFC card, enable its counter or lock it, and dump it. |
| [`nfc_tap`](commands/nfc_tap.md) | `passport_nfc_tap` | `nfc` | yes | yes | yes | Tap the NFC card with a virtual phone: read or write NDEF, or send raw frames. |
| [`plan_flash`](commands/plan_flash.md) | `passport_plan_flash` | `device` | yes | yes | no | Plan what would be written to a real AI Passport, without opening it. |
| [`power`](commands/power.md) | `passport_power` | `power` | yes | yes | yes | Press or hold the power button, or set the battery. |
| [`run`](commands/run.md) | `passport_run` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Advance virtual time, or wait until a matcher fires. |
| [`scenario`](commands/scenario.md) | `passport_scenario` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Run or validate a scenario file, and write the JUnit report. |
| [`screenshot`](commands/screenshot.md) | `passport_screenshot` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Capture the panel as a PNG artifact, optionally comparing it with an expected image. |
| [`serial`](commands/serial.md) | `passport_serial` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Read new console output from a cursor, or write bytes. |
| [`snapshot`](commands/snapshot.md) | `passport_snapshot` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Save, restore, list, fork, export and import instance state. |
| [`start`](commands/start.md) | `passport_start` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Create an instance from a firmware and boot it. |
| [`status`](commands/status.md) | `passport_status` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Report every instance's lifecycle, virtual time and clock. |
| [`stop`](commands/stop.md) | `passport_stop` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Destroy an instance and flush its artifacts. |
| [`ui`](commands/ui.md) | `passport_ui` | `core` | yes | yes | yes | Read the pruned LVGL tree, or only the lines that changed since a revision. |
| [`usb`](commands/usb.md) | `passport_usb` | `power` | yes | yes | yes | Plug or unplug the USB cable, or open or close the host console. |
| [`wifi_ap`](commands/wifi_ap.md) | `passport_wifi_ap` | `radio` | yes | yes | yes | Add, update, remove or list one scripted Wi-Fi access point. |
